import { setup, assign, enqueueActions } from "../../../src/index.js"
import { agent, child } from "./support.js"

/** Detect contextual types erased to any. */
type IsAny<T> = 0 extends (1 & T) ? true : false
/** Require exact contextual types rather than assignability. */
type Equal<A, B> = (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false
/** Turn each type expectation into a compiler obligation. */
const exact = <T extends true>(): void => undefined
/** The setup's declared context. */
type Context = { count: number }
/** Event names can equal config member names. */
type Event = { type: "actions" } | { type: "input" }
/** The setup checks structural dictionary keys independently of callback members. */
const s = setup({ types: {} as { context: Context; input: { start: number }; events: Event }, actors: { agent, child } })

/** State and event names remain structural even when they name callback members. */
export const collisions = s.createMachine({
  context: ({ input }) => ({ count: input.start }),
  initial: "input",
  entry: [assign({ count: ({ context }) => context.count }), ({ event }) => void event, enqueueActions(({ enqueue }) => void enqueue)],
  states: {
    input: {
      entry: [
        ({ context, event }) => {
          exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof context>, false>>()
          exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event>, false>>()
          exact<Equal<typeof context, Context>>()
          exact<Equal<typeof event, Event>>()
        },
        assign({ count: ({ context }) => context.count }),
        enqueueActions(({ enqueue }) => enqueue.assign({ count: 1 }))
      ],
      on: {
        actions: {
          guard: ({ event, context }) => {
            exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event>, false>>()
            exact<Equal<typeof event, { type: "actions" }>>()
            exact<Equal<typeof context, Context>>()
            return true
          },
          target: "done",
          actions: ({ event }) => { exact<Equal<typeof event, { type: "actions" }>>() }
        },
        input: { target: "done", actions: assign({ count: ({ context }) => context.count }) }
      },
      after: { 1: "actions" }
    },
    actions: { after: { 1: "guard" } },
    guard: { after: { 1: "context" } },
    context: { after: { 1: "entry" } },
    entry: { after: { 1: "exit" } },
    exit: { after: { 1: "output" } },
    output: { after: { 1: "done" } },
    done: { type: "final" }
  }
})

/** An explicitly undefined guard is an unguarded progress transition. */
export const undefinedGuard = s.createMachine({ context: { count: 0 }, initial: "x", states: { x: { always: { guard: undefined, target: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } } })
